toolsPreview.name: job_offer_worth_it
toolsPreview.description: Is this job offer worth it? — Compares two jobs on real take-home pay after federal, state, FICA, 401(k) and commute, and says which wins and by how much. Returns a one-line verdict plus a link to the full interactive page with the numbers pre-filled. Accepts only numbers and enums.

toolsPreview.name: freelance_rate_floor
toolsPreview.description: Freelance Rate Floor — Calculates the hourly rate a freelancer must bill to match a given salary after self-employment tax and lost benefits. Returns a one-line verdict plus a link to the full interactive page with the numbers pre-filled. Accepts only numbers and enums.

toolsPreview.name: roth_vs_traditional
toolsPreview.description: Roth vs Traditional — Compares Roth vs Traditional retirement contributions: the break-even retirement tax rate and which to choose. Returns a one-line verdict plus a link to the full interactive page with the numbers pre-filled. Accepts only numbers and enums.

toolsPreview.name: best_filing_status
toolsPreview.description: Married Filing Jointly vs Separately — Compares Married Filing Jointly vs Separately for a couple and says which keeps more, including lost credits. Returns a one-line verdict plus a link to the full interactive page with the numbers pre-filled. Accepts only numbers and enums.

toolsPreview.name: raise_bonus_value
toolsPreview.description: Raise / Bonus True Value — Shows how much of a raise or bonus you actually keep after marginal tax and lifestyle inflation. Returns a one-line verdict plus a link to the full interactive page with the numbers pre-filled. Accepts only numbers and enums.
